reason: These are DERIVATIVES OF PUBLISHER FIGURES -- an overlay or crop of a copyrighted figure is protected expression, unlike the numeric values read off it, which are facts (POLICY_DECISIONS.md P1). They were committed to a PUBLIC repository and are removed from the working tree AND from every commit in git history by a rewrite on 2026-11-10.
kept_locally: The files remain on local disk, untracked and matched by the existing slashless *.png rule in .gitignore, so the audit trail for F-017, F-018, F-019 and the three curations' geometry checks is still inspectable by anyone with the repo checkout and the source PDFs. Nothing about the FINDINGS is lost: each is reproducible by re-running that curation's own render step against the source PDF.

history_rewrite.pre_rewrite_head: DELIBERATELY NOT RECORDED HERE. GitHub serves an unreachable commit by its SHA until it garbage-collects, so printing the pre-rewrite head in a PUBLIC file would hand back the very objects the rewrite removed. It is in the local backup bundle named above, and in that bundle only.
